deterministic_findings.title: Shell execution in added code
deterministic_findings.recommendation: Verify no untrusted input can reach the command; prefer argv lists with shell=False.

reviewer_reports.summary: The change adds agent seat support with proper validation, timeout handling, cleanup, and test coverage; no reliability or safety issues detected.
Agent seat names ignore the occurrence count in build_provider, causing multiple agent seats with the same name to overwrite each other in the seats dictionary.

findings.title: Untitled finding
findings.recommendation: Disambiguate the seat name and label when occurrence > 1 (e.g. name = f'{agent_name}#{occurrence}' if occurrence > 1 else agent_name) so duplicate agent seats are not overwritten in the build_providers dictionary.
